fit_reason: Although posted under boats by owner, this listing is run by a marina (Knotty Oar Marina handles calls, test drives, storage and winterization offers), so it reads as dealer or brokered stock rather than a private owner sale.
findings: Blue and black side panels look clean and glossy in all exterior shots
Pontoon tubes look uniformly clean with no visible waterline scum
Bimini top and seat backs look clean from what is visible
Interior is only seen from outside the rails, so its condition can't be fully judged
message: Hi, we saw the listing for the 2023 Crest pontoon. The blue panels and the tubes already look clean and sharp in the photos. If you ever want a pre-sale interior detail or a polish on the tubes, we come to you, so just let us know if you'd like a quote.
